ideas.title: The Role of Private Equity in Child Care Fraud
ideas.description: An investigation into the allegations of private equity firms contributing to soaring child care prices and potential fraud in the sector.
questions: What is the extent of private equity involvement?
How do these firms impact child care prices?
ideas.insight: This story could uncover a significant pattern of financial manipulation and wrongdoing in the child care sector.

ideas.title: Minnesota AG's Oversight in Medicaid Fraud
ideas.description: An examination of Minnesota AG Keith Ellison's efforts to oversee and combat Medicaid fraud in the state.
questions: What are the key findings of the investigation?
How effective has the AG's office been in combating fraud?
ideas.insight: This story could shed light on the effectiveness of state oversight in combating Medicaid fraud.
